name: run-guard
description: Stops Claude from starting overlapping test runs, deleting test evidence, or touching protected hosts

protectedHosts.title: Protected hosts
protectedHosts.description: Comma-separated hostnames/IPs Claude must never run commands against (e.g. prod-broker.example.com, 10.20.0.5). Empty = off.

blockConcurrent.title: Block overlapping test runs
blockConcurrent.description: Refuse to start robot/pabot/playwright test while another one is running on this machine.

protectReports.title: Protect test reports
protectReports.description: Refuse commands that delete output.xml, log/report.html, results/, test-results/, playwright-report/ and similar.
